ai_note: Design, specifications and testing by the author; code written with the assistance of AI tools.
guide_missing: The user guide is not installed.
log_empty: The engine has not written anything yet.
banner_no_model: No model found: copy one into the models folder.
gpu_sub: Much faster; turn off if the driver gives problems
threads_sub: This computer has {n} physical cores: use as many
font_size_sub: Ctrl++ and Ctrl+− change it, Ctrl+0 returns to the system size
app_description: Reads a Markdown document aloud, or SRT subtitles following their timing, with a speech synthesis model that runs on this computer through llama-tts from ruscallama-engine. Saves the audio as WAV, FLAC, Opus or MP3. Nothing leaves the machine.
empty_desc: Open a Markdown document or SRT subtitles. The voice is generated on this computer: nothing is sent over the internet.
nothing_desc: The file contains no text to read aloud.
completed: Audio ready. Listen to it and save it.
srt_report: Subtitles sped up: {faster}; moved later: {late} (at most {seconds} s).
discard_body: The generated audio has not been saved: if you continue it will be lost.
banner_no_engine: The voice engine is not installed: ruscallama-engine with llama-tts is needed.
err_no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg is not installed: it is needed to put together and save the audio.
err_engine: Speech synthesis stopped with an error
err_audio: Could not process the generated audio
err_empty: The file has no text to read
model_hint: Speech synthesis models in GGUF, each with its mmproj file in the same folder, for example Qwen3-TTS.
create_voice_sub: Try the model’s voices and keep the one you like
create_voice_desc: Listen to a trial voice. If you do not like it, try another one; when you find the right one, give it a name and keep it: it becomes the reference voice, the same for every sentence.
max_speed_sub: How much a sentence that does not fit in its subtitle’s time can be sped up
normalize_sub: Even volume, as in podcasts (EBU R128)
seed_sub: The same seed gives the same reading; change it for another performance
